execution.description: Attempted the repository's pinned canonical Linux/Docker wrapper from Ubuntu WSL, then inspected the worktree identity after the first sandbox denial was retried with approval.

expected: The canonical wrapper should run the focused Motor contract, campaign and expansion tests.
observed: The approved WSL attempt stopped before Docker or test dispatch. The managed worktree's .git file contains an absolute Windows Git-directory path, which WSL resolves as an invalid relative path; the wrapper therefore cannot establish that it belongs to the repository root. No canonical test ran and no repository file changed.
keep: Treat local Windows results as diagnostic and PR CI as canonical authority.
Fail before claiming canonical validation when repository identity cannot be established.
change: Let PR CI run the pinned canonical environment for this managed-worktree delivery.
